'''Garnac's hunting guild''' was made up of a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The guild would travel around the galaxy including to systems such as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], capturing unknowing victims and delivering them to [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] in order to be hunted. Occasionally, the Trandoshans would capture [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Trandoshan [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] was sent to Felucia on a mission to capture new victims to be used in the hunt. Lo-Taren arrived at the scene of an [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|ambush of a droid base]]. There, he spotted and captured [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to be brought back to the Trandoshan moon to be hunted.

Once arriving on the Trandoshan moon, the Trandoshans dumped their prey onto the beach of [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]] and opened fire on them, killing a majority of the prisoners while a few escaped. Ahsoka met up with a group of other Padawan who had been captured and worked together to escape the moon. They took down a drop ship carrying new prey and found the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on board and brought him with. Chewbacca built a radio which caught a signal from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] while the Padawans and Chewbacca went to take down the Trandoshan fortress.

While the Padawans and Chewbacca fought off the Trandoshans on the flying fortress, General [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarful]] and several Wookiee soldiers, being transported aboard the [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']]. The Wookiee reinforcements joined in the attack and by the end, all of the Trandoshans except for Krix, Ramy and Smug had been killed and the guild had been disbanded.
